# Copilot guidance — Nakagawa Recomp

Read [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md), the single policy authority, before acting. This file adds no
rules. Start at [Where to start](../AGENTS.md#where-to-start): it covers building, testing, the
hard limits and what a good pull request looks like. The numbered sections are the full contract,
and the "Maintainer process" section applies only to the maintainer's own agents.

Use [`docs/README.md`](../docs/README.md) to choose maintained technical guidance and
[`REVIEW.md`](../REVIEW.md) for review-specific checks.
